plain.name: Simple / original
plain.description: Original walls and hip or cone roof.

cottage.name: Timber cottage
cottage.description: Steep gables, exposed timber braces and a chimney.

mediterranean.name: Mediterranean villa
mediterranean.description: Low tiled hips, plaster walls and arched window surrounds.

japanese.name: Japanese-inspired house
japanese.description: Broad flared eaves, timber posts and fine window lattice.

modern.name: Modern pavilion
modern.description: Thin floating roof, broad openings and restrained concrete bands.

gothic.name: Gothic-inspired stone
gothic.description: High gables, pointed window tracery and tapered buttresses.

adobe.name: Adobe dwelling
adobe.description: Earth-toned plaster, rounded parapet caps and projecting timber vigas.

spanish.name: Spanish-inspired house
spanish.description: Terracotta gables, arched surrounds and a curving mission parapet.

apartment.name: Brick apartment
apartment.description: Repeated window bays, brick piers, stone lintels and a roof cornice.

fantasy.name: Storybook fantasy
fantasy.description: Sweeping tent roof, copper spire and ornamental starburst frames.

alien.name: Alien habitat
alien.description: Ribbed elliptical shell and repeating exoskeleton fins.

surreal.name: Surreal house
surreal.description: Asymmetric rising roof, off-axis crown and concentric window ornaments.

organic.name: Organic shelter
organic.description: Soft domed canopy, branching supports and leaf-like window ribs.

nouveau.name: Art Nouveau-inspired
nouveau.description: Copper canopy, curling stems and flowing floral window tracery.

deco.name: Art Deco-inspired
deco.description: Stepped roof crown, vertical fins and geometric fan details.

dwarven.name: Dwarven stone hall
dwarven.description: Heavy low gable, oversized stone braces and angular doorway ornament.

shack.name: Rough shack
shack.description: Sloping shed roof, uneven board battens and patched timber bracing.
